notes.title: Dev Update 4.15.12.02
notes.content:
[b][h3]UNLEASH HELL PATCH NOTES[/h3][/b]
[i]BUILD 4.15.12.02 - 8 June 2021[/i]

Major Changes:
[list]
[*] Fire Barrels are no longer safe to stand on.
[*] Added Splash Damage to the Crossbow's SphereShot ability. Be careful!
[*] Fixed an issue where all the weapons were not resetting when using the Reset All Weapons Button in the HellShop.
[*] Fixed an issue with HellPoints counting up past the Demo Cap.
[*] Pickups are now easier to pickup.
[/list]

Misc:
[list]
[*] Performance optimizations.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Update 4.15.12
notes.content:
[b][h3]UNLEASH HELL PATCH NOTES[/h3][/b]
[i]BUILD 4.15.12 - 6 June 2021[/i]

Major Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the Crossbow "SphereShot" (The Charged Ability) that was setting the damage radius to 0.
[*] Fixed an issue with Demonic Charge range being set to 0.
[*] Removed VSYNC 2 option from Options Menu as it was causing poor performance when selected.
[*] Re-enabled the Hit Reactions on the LilWalker, they were accidentally disabled in the last update.
[/list]

Misc:
[list]
[*] Performance optimizations.
[/list]

notes.title: New Graphics Styles available in UNLEASH HELL!
notes.content:
Now you can enjoy UNLEASH HELL with a different look by choosing one of the new Graphics Styles available in the options menu. 
[h3]Current Graphics Styles:[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Default Mode -- Full Hi-Res Glory
    [*]Retro Mode -- Retro Pixelated look, full adjustable for just the right look.
    [*]Cartoon Mode -- Cartoon Style graphics, nuff said.
    [*]Retro Cartoon Mode -- Cartoon Style graphics but Retro!
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h1]"CARTOON" Mode:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35136267/7add65412f7b23b65e2e0921de406413eef1f62b.png[/img]

More to come! Don't forget to add UNLEASH HELL to your WishList!
